Use this when a set of comments needs a visible response. Give each distinct issue an ID, including comments you need to investigate or discuss before changing the draft.


<details class="template-copy">
<summary>Open the blank copyable template</summary>

Copy this plain-text version into your approved project record. Repeat entry fields as needed and remove prompts that do not apply. The guidance and examples below help you complete it.

```text
Feedback response matrix

Blank matrix

ID: F-001
Feedback: [quote or faithful summary]
Underlying issue: [ ]
Decision: accept / adapt / investigate / discuss / decline
Proposed response: [ ]
Location/evidence: [ ]
Status: open / done

Unresolved conflicts: [ ]
Decision owner/date: [ ]
New risks or cross-document changes: [ ]
```

</details>

## Check your record

Mark a response done after checking the revised passage and any affected tables or claims. If you decide against a change, retain the reason and any required agreement.

## Scenario test

Two supervisors recommend incompatible structures. Both comments remain visible, the conflict is recorded and a decision meeting is requested; the student does not silently implement the last comment received.
